title: David Jay Brown's field guide to DMT entities: machine elves and insectoid surgeons

tellings.quote: you know, to describe and there's a book by David J. Brown, illustrated field guide to DMT entities,

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to a book by David Jay Brown called Illustrated Field Guide to DMT Entities. DMT is a powerful psychedelic drug, and people who take it often report meeting beings. According to the story, the book catalogues them, from the "machine elves" made famous by the writer Terence McKenna to insect-like surgeons, which matters because, if those beings are real, the drug could be a doorway to other minds.
